'''Tharsis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]] who was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberation of Balmorra]] on the [[Moraine Gulch]] Territory, he was lured into a trap and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual.
